prerelease_meaning: The vendor's doc site documents functions for in-development plugin versions ahead of release. prerelease: true means the function's version_introduced was higher than plugin_version_released_at_build when this catalog was built -- it exists in the docs but may not be in the shipping plugin yet. Once that version ships, the flag is stale until the next rebuild.
deprecated_meaning: Listed on the vendor's deprecated functions page (https://www.mbsplugins.eu/deprecated.md) at build time. Deprecated functions still exist and run, but the vendor recommends a replacement -- check the function's own doc page for what to use instead.
count_note: Independent review on 2026-10-27 found 7,859 unique function names in the primary tables of 169 component pages linked from index.md plus deprecated.md, exactly matching this catalog. The index headline advertises 7,971 (112 more). The cause is unresolved; this is not proof of 112 missing functions or that no other listing contains additional names. See coverage-review.json for method, hashes and limits.
source: Live crawl of https://www.mbsplugins.eu (enumerated via the markdown mirror index.md/component_X.md, detail parsed from the .shtml pages).
license: Cataloged functions have free/licensed/unknown_license status; vendor-wide completeness is not established. See status_counts and status_meaning.

status_meaning.free: Vendor doc page states this function is free to use (works unregistered).
status_meaning.licensed: Vendor doc page states this function checks for a license (requires the base MBS plugin to be registered).
status_meaning.unknown_license: Vendor doc page has neither marker. Status genuinely unconfirmed; verify against the live url before relying on this being free or licensed.

addon_components.DynaPDF: Requires a separate DynaPDF licence (Starter, Lite, Pro or Enterprise, plus an optional PDF/A add-on) on top of the base MBS plugin. Check current pricing with Monkeybread.
addon_components.XL: Requires a separate LibXL licence on top of the base MBS plugin. Check current pricing with Monkeybread.
addon_components.Saxon: Requires a separate Saxon-PE or Saxon-EE licence on top of the base MBS plugin. Check current pricing with Monkeybread.

content_policy.retained: Factual API metadata and CadenceUX CC BY 4.0 synthesis
content_policy.omitted: Vendor documentation prose, vendor parameter descriptions, vendor notes and vendor example code
content_policy.reason: The vendor documentation sites do not declare a redistribution licence. Consult the linked vendor page for full prose and examples.

field_note: Each entry retains signature, parameter names/flags, result, version introduced, platform support, licensing status, deprecation flag, see-also links and the vendor URL. Descriptions and examples are not copied; see the URL.
